samir: Hey folks — first week here, trying to build the runtime from source and hitting a linker error I can't grok. Who should I ping for CUDA/toolkit compat?

samir: Build command: `./build.sh --targets=runtime`

samir: Link error (excerpt):
```
/opt/cuda/lib64/libcublas.so: undefined reference to `cublasLtMatmul`
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
samir: Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA toolkit installed via apt, driver from package repo.
devon: welcome! :wave: first guesses — mismatch between toolkit headers and runtime libs or missing cublasLt dev package. what do `nvidia-smi` and `nvcc --version` show?
samir: paste: `nvidia-smi` -> "NVIDIA-SMI 535.54.03 Driver Version: 535.54.03 CUDA Version: 12.1"
samir: `nvcc --version` -> "Cuda compilation tools, release 12.1, V12.1.105"
ryan: cublasLt symbols landed around cuBLAS 11.8+, but linking problems usually mean either lib paths are mixing a different CUDA install or the build is not linking `-lcublasLt`. can you share the final link line?
samir: final link line includes: `-L/opt/cuda/lib64 -lcublas -lcudart -lstdc++` (no `-lcublasLt`). I tried adding `-lcublasLt` manually and still got undefined refs.
devon: if you have multiple CUDA installs (system pkg + apt), headers might be from one and libs from another. check `/usr/local/cuda` symlink + `echo $CUDA_HOME`. also run `ldd <path-to-binary>` after partial link to see which libcublas it's resolving to.
maria: onboarding tip: we vendor a small shim in `third_party/cublas_compat` for older toolkits. run `scripts/setup_cuda.sh` from repo root — it sets `CUDA_HOME` and adjusts `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` for the build. also try `rm -rf build && ./build.sh --clean` so CMake doesn't pick stale cached vars.
samir: ran `scripts/setup_cuda.sh` — it pointed me to `/opt/cuda-12.2`. I didn't have 12.2 installed.
ryan: yeah, our CI/testing images are on 12.2+ with driver >=535.86. the apt-provided 12.1 libs sometimes lack cublasLt symbols expected by newer runtime.
samir: installed CUDA 12.2 toolkit (from NVIDIA runfile) and upgraded driver to 535.86. Linked again and build succeeded. :tada:
maria: awesome, welcome aboard and glad that worked. please add a short note to #eng-runtime with your OS/toolkit combo so we can update the docs if needed.
onboard-bot: Welcome samir! If you haven't, please complete the "Runtime dev setup" checklist in Notion.
samir: will do, thanks all — shout if you want me to add the note or a small PR to docs.
_description: Onboarding thread: new hire hits cublasLt linker error, team helps debug CUDA toolkit/driver mismatch and suggests setup script and environment fixes
